title: Offer cards composition
question: Design / Supervision / FF&E become a horizontal scroll of image cards. Lock one presentation (world stays Parchment Atelier).

options.label: Plate-led offer scroll
options.thesis: Three scrubbed plates drift sideways — Design, Supervision, FF&E — each with a quiet caption block under the media.
options.viewport: Section title in shell. Below: full-bleed horizontal track (first card aligned to shell inset) of three cards — aspect plate, then serif title + short Inter body. Six operational proofs sit as a hairline ledger under the track.
options.risk: Reads like a third TeamProofRow if cards stay too narrow and caption-only.

raised.raise: Cards read wider than team plates so body copy can carry the service promise, not only a name.

options.label: Atelier dossier cards
options.thesis: Each service opens like a dossier plate: tall scrubbed photo, then a measured title and body — still one horizontal track.
options.viewport: Shell title. Horizontal track of three tall dossier cards (plate ~3/4). Title + body under each. Six proofs remain as a compact ledger below.
options.risk: Tall cards can feel like team portraits if body stays too short.

options.label: Service + proof paired
options.lineage: Offer card carries one operational proof
options.thesis: Each card pairs the service plate with one factual proof line drawn from Schedule–Implementation — still three cards, still horizontal.
options.viewport: Title in shell. Three wide cards: plate, Design|Supervision|FF&E title, short body, then one grey meta proof (e.g. Schedule / Team / Budget). Remaining proofs as ledger or folded.
options.risk: Pairing can invent false mappings if proofs are forced onto the wrong service.
